description_optimization.optimized_description:
Workflow Description: Automated Receipt Processing and Organization

Trigger:
The workflow is initiated when a new receipt is uploaded to a specified Google Drive folder. This is accomplished using the Google Drive Trigger node, which monitors the designated folder for new file uploads.

Data Sources and APIs:
1. Google Drive: To receive and monitor new receipt uploads.
2. OCR (Optical Character Recognition) Service: To extract text from the uploaded receipt images.
3. AI Agent: To analyze the extracted text and structure the data into specific categories.
4. Google Sheets: To store the organized receipt data for easy tracking and management.

Operations and Processing Steps:
1. **Google Drive Trigger**: Set up the Google Drive Trigger node to monitor a specific folder for new files. This node will activate the workflow whenever a new receipt is uploaded.
   
2. **OCR Extraction**: Once a new receipt is detected, the workflow will utilize an OCR service to extract text from the receipt image. This step converts the visual information on the receipt into machine-readable text.

3. **Data Structuring with AI Agent**: After the text extraction, the workflow will pass the extracted text to an AI Agent. The AI Agent will analyze the text and identify key components of the receipt, such as:
   - Vendor Name
   - Date of Purchase
   - Total Amount
   - Tax Amount
   The AI Agent will structure this information into a predefined format for easy interpretation.

4. **Google Sheets Integration**: The structured receipt data will then be sent to a Google Sheets node. This node will append the organized data into a specified Google Sheet, allowing for easy tracking and management of receipts. Each entry in the Google Sheet will correspond to a new receipt, ensuring that all relevant information is captured and stored.

Final Output or Action:
The final action of this workflow is the successful storage of organized receipt data into a Google Sheet. This output enables users to easily track their expenses and manage their receipts in a structured manner.

Setup Instructions:
- The setup process for this workflow takes approximately 15-20 minutes.
- Users will need to create a Google Drive folder specifically for uploading receipts.
- A Google Sheet must be prepared in advance to store the results of the workflow.
- Configuration steps include setting up the Google Drive Trigger, the OCR extraction process, the AI Agent for data analysis, and the connection to Google Sheets for data storage.

For detailed instructions and explanations on setting up this workflow, refer to the n8n Starter Session tutorial series available at [this YouTube playlist](https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLWYu7XaUG3XOJwOOGiX89SQ_w67vw3dq7).
description_optimization.original_description:
### How it works:
- Automatically detects when a new receipt is uploaded to Google Drive.
- Extracts text from the receipt using OCR.
- Uses an AI Agent to analyze the extracted data and structure it (e.g., vendor, date, total, tax).
- Saves the organized receipt data into a Google Sheet for easy tracking.

### Set up steps:
- Setup takes around 15–20 minutes.
- You'll need a Google Drive folder for receipts and a Google Sheet to store results.
- Configure your Google Drive Trigger, OCR extraction, AI Agent, and Google Sheets connection.

Detailed instructions and explanations are included in [this n8n Starter Session tutorial series](https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLWYu7XaUG3XOJwOOGiX89SQ_w67vw3dq7).
